test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Ram runs faster than Sumit whereas Sumit is faster than Hardik and Tarun. After a training of three months Hardik will be able to beat Ram. But Tarun would not be able to beat even Sumit. If a competitive race takes place after three months training, which of the following could be the sequence of the top three runners?
solution:
**Given:**

Ram runs faster than Sumit whereas Sumit is faster than Hardik and Tarun

Ram > Sumit > Hardik and Tarun

**After a training of three months.**

Hardik will be able to beat Ram

Hardik > Ram > Sumit > Tarun

So, top three runners is Hardik, Ram and Sumit.

**Hence, Hardik, Ram and Sumit is the correct answer.**
